text: The shoot of a plant seedling was exposed to light from one direction for 48 hours.
Fig. 2.1 shows the effect on the growth of this shoot.
There are two hypotheses about how this growth response may be controlled.
Hypothesis A Auxin is broken down by light on the side of the shoot closest to the light.
Hypothesis B Auxin moves from the side of the shoot closest to the light to the shaded side.
In an investigation to test these two hypotheses, the tips of 24 shoots were removed and
divided into 4 groups of 6 shoot tips.
